outline_action: Retrieve the primary studies cited in Section 6.3 (e.g., references 182, 184) to determine if they contain intratumoral metabolite quantification. Conduct a targeted search for metabolomics studies specifically profiling the tumor microenvironment in ICI-treated patients, focusing on methodologies that report absolute concentration units in tissue biopsies alongside peripheral samples.
remaining_gap: This review does not report absolute physiological concentrations (e.g., μmol/g or μM) of inosine or SCFAs inside the human tumor microenvironment. It references associations in plasma and fecal samples but does not describe paired tumor tissue and serum/stool measurements from prospective human studies with specific quantitative data. The success criterion requiring identified prospective human studies with absolute tissue concentrations remains open.
